title: Latency Forensics — Find the Real Rollout Regression

checks.name: reproducible analysis
checks.command: bun run src/cli.ts data/requests.csv --json out/analysis.json --markdown analysis.md --html report.html
checks.details: The supplied dataset produced JSON, Markdown, and HTML outputs.

summary: Candidate is not broadly slower. Control mean 316.75 ms vs candidate 604.7 ms is a mix shift plus one bad cell: EU × mobile × cold, which is slower even at overlapping 720–960 KB payloads and contains all four 504s. Warm desktop and US mobile cold are faster for candidate. Hold unguarded rollout; do not treat the aggregate gap as a global candidate regression.
